isolated-frontier-house.name: Isolated Frontier House
isolated-frontier-house.description: Single-story timber dwelling with gray, patchy thatched roof in a forest clearing. Heavy timber door with simple brace. Two small windows with bar-able shutters. Packed-earth floor, stained from long occupation.

interior.mainRoom: Central hearth, rough-hewn table with two stools, wide bed covered by heavy bear-variant pelt blanket (wolf-variant pelt folded at foot). Rafters hold hanging herbs and roots. Warm, smells of woodsmoke, dried meat, and pelts.
interior.storageRoom: Adjoining cooler space with shelves of dwindling jars, spare linen, tools, and preserved food. Narrow cot rarely used.

exterior.clearing: Trodden flat from training. Cold ash pile from burned body at far edge. Forest presses close on all sides.
exterior.notes: Isolated. No other structures. Defensible only by remoteness.

currentContents: Bear-bone knife and original bone knife
